blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.focus_note: Loosen up, half-speed swings, no target focus yet.

blocks.name: Feel work
blocks.focus_note: Slow, exaggerated reps building the feel for: Club speed.

blocks.name: Drill work
blocks.focus_note: Full-speed reps of the drill(s) targeting: Club speed.

blocks.name: Transfer
blocks.focus_note: Normal full swings, carrying the drill feel into a real swing.

blocks.name: Pressure test
blocks.focus_note: Pick a target, score makes/misses, simulate on-course pressure.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.focus_note: Easy short-game shots to finish, no swing thoughts.
